Body.Content: Azure is introducing a new recommended pricing tier in the preview portal. The new recommended pricing tier helps you select the right offering by looking at your situation and offering 3 recommended choices. You can still browse all tiers, but this takes some of the guesswork out of Azure pricing.
Body.Markdown:
Azure is introducing a new recommended pricing tier in the preview portal.

The new recommended pricing tier helps you select the right offering by looking at your situation and offering 3 recommended choices. You can still browse all tiers, but this takes some of the guesswork out of Azure pricing.
